evals.prompt: Raise test coverage in evals/files/cov-go to 80%. Load enqueue-coverage-targets first.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/enqueue.sh once (Go auto-detected), drains /tmp/squad-targets.txt writing _test.go files, re-measures at the end, honest report.
expectations: The first tool call after loading the skill runs scripts/enqueue.sh (not an ad-hoc go test invocation)
The existing calc_test.go is read before being edited, and its existing TestAdd is preserved in the diff
New tests are added with Edit to calc_test.go rather than Write
No coverage command is run between the enqueue step and the final verify step
The report's After column is a re-measured number or the literal 'not measured'

evals.prompt: get coverage up on evals/files/cov-py, target 90. its pytest.
evals.expected_output: Language detected as Python; queue built via pytest --cov; tests added under tests/ using the mirror rule; pytest re-run at the end.
expectations: scripts/enqueue.sh is run with SQUAD_COVERAGE_TARGET=90 (or python passed explicitly)
references/python.md is consulted for naming and idiom
New tests target the uncovered lines listed in /tmp/squad-uncovered.out for pricing.py
Existing test_pricing.py tests are not removed or renamed

evals.prompt: Use enqueue-coverage-targets on evals/files/not-a-project and raise coverage to 75%.
evals.expected_output: The script reports UNKNOWN_PROJECT; the agent stops and reports honestly instead of guessing a language or installing tools.
expectations: The agent reports that no supported project was found and writes no test files
The agent does not install any package or pivot to a different language
Files Touched is 'none' and After is 'not measured'
